prelaunch_updates.text: Partner mainnet went live Mon 10/26 (invite-only via the Bread wallet; codes go out in waves to the early-access list, deposits capped under about $1,232; the network is temporary and will reset before public mainnet). No token yet. Polygon says Miden 'may' airdrop about 10% of supply to POL stakers (non-binding, undated).

OPEN CAMPAIGN (launched Mon 10/26, no end date): Antseed Points. Paid AI usage through the network earns points; each weekly epoch's ANTS pool is claimable every Thursday (buyer cap 5% of pool). Free models and 0x providers earn nothing. ANTS is still non-transferable on Base, so there is no market; fake 'Ants' tokens trade on Solana, BSC, Arc and Robinhood chain. Only antseed.com and @AntSeed.

@GenLayer at 6:47 AM CT Mon 10/26: 'Registration closes today.' Still no time of day, so treat it as closing any hour. Only airdrop.genlayer.com from @GenLayer; it never asks for a seed phrase. Any GEN token trading now is fake.

Arthur Hayes (Oct 26, 2:17 AM CT): Devnet opens 'in the coming days' for miners, validators and agents. Devnet participation does NOT count toward any token allocation; testnet/airdrop comes after. @flop_labs quoted it: 'Devnet coming very soon.' Public testnet target still Tue 11/3.

Hotcoin opened PEARL/USDT spot trading Mon 10/26 5:00 AM CT (CEX, not a DEX route). Third-party bear case (Blockworks researcher via Coincamps): about 85% first-year inflation. Traders note a slide from about $2.55; CoinGecko shows $1.83, flat 24h, FDV $3.9B vs $655M cap.

CORRECTION: the official @GenLayer post of Oct 21 says GEN airdrop registration is 'Open until Monday, October 26'. No time of day is given, so treat it as ending early Mon 10/26. Season 1 final snapshot is Sun 10/25; Season 2 Points start Mon 10/26 and carry over. Claims open on 'THE DAY' (undated): 20%, then 20% a month. Registering locks the wallet. The only link is airdrop.genlayer.com from @GenLayer, never by DM, and it never asks for a seed phrase.

OPEN CAMPAIGNS: (1) Kaito Katalyst Epoch 3 opened Fri 10/24, the final epoch; 0.30% of TMT supply for 450 creators, winners Mon 11/23, unlocks at TGE. (2) BNB Chain 'Set and Earn' agent tasks close Thu 11/5 (merch). (3) TermiX Points Season 1, no end date and no TMT conversion. No TGE date. Escrow contracts unaudited, upgradeable proxy. Only agent.family links from @termix_ai.

OPEN CAMPAIGN (no closing date): Quip Points. Sign in daily, hold value in a V1 quantum wallet, swap on QuipSwap, run a node; QP convert to $QUIP at TGE by leaderboard rank. Requires linking X and following @quipnetwork. No TGE date. Only points.quip.network; referral links are unsafe.

Public testnet working target Tue 11/3, about 90 days; mainnet and TGE Q1 2027 (early Feb). Devnet earns nothing. Official page says no token, claim, presale or airdrop is live. @FlopNetwork is NOT official (official: @flop_labs).
TGE 'Q4' only from third-party posts; the Sept target passed and there is no official date or PRIME points conversion. Official account claims 3.18M agents (unverified).
